dedupe_keys.name: muse multimodal separators for efficient route planning in transportation networks

description: Amine Falek publishes the Île-de-France inputs used to evaluate MUSE multimodal route planning. The August 2021 ZIP archive contains a raw OpenStreetMap extract, public-transit GTFS data, multimodal graphs partitioned into 100 to 500 cells, finite automata and preprocessing graph overlays. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0 and provides free access. The linked Java repository is currently marked MIT, which applies separately from deposited data and any upstream OpenStreetMap terms. The collection can support route-query benchmarks and tests of multimodal graph preprocessing for transport simulations. Source extraction dates, service-day coverage and the precise internal graph schema remain unknown from the summary. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this prepared network bundle. Repository metadata and its minimal README were inspected, but the archive and Java code were not downloaded or executed.
